title: Webhook envelope
description: Common envelope for every webhook sent to SCG Shop ERP. Signed with X-Webhook-Signature (HMAC-SHA256 over `timestamp.raw_body`). Receivers must ignore unknown fields.

id.description: Unique event id; equals X-Webhook-Id; dedupe key per source

shop_id.description: Partner shop id, e.g. PP-SHOP-104552 or SFM-CM-00871
